item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Top Iranian Negotiators Arrive in Qatar for Talks on Peace Deal
item.description: President Trump gave conflicting signals over how much progress had been made in the talks. Both the United States and Iran suggested that a breakthrough was not imminent.

item.title: Middle East war live: Trump urges Saudi Arabia, Qatar to sign Abraham Accords in Iran peace push
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Monday urged Muslim-majority countries including Saudi Arabia, Qatar and Pakistan to normalise ties with Israel, saying it “should be mandatory” for them to join the Abraham Accords as part of efforts to end the Iran conflict. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio earlier said that a deal could materialise "today". Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: Possible Iran-US deal: What we know about the key issues on both sides
item.description: The United States and Iran have downplayed prospects for a rapid deal to end the Middle East war, despite signs of progress in talks. Key sticking points remain over Iran’s nuclear programme, control of the Strait of Hormuz, sanctions relief and a possible ceasefire in Lebanon, with both sides signalling that major issues are still unresolved.

item.title: Trump’s Pressure Had Little Effect on Iran’s Terms for a Peace Deal
item.description: President Trump had sought to force Tehran to accept American demands for a peace deal with a mixture of threats and military operations.

item.title: Over 20 taken to hospital after unknown substance allegedly sprayed in Tokyo
item.description: More than 20 people developed sore throats near a luxury department store in Tokyo’s Ginza shopping area

item.title: Fate of War in Lebanon Rests Mostly With Outside Powers
item.description: A U.S.-Iran peace deal could calm the conflict in Lebanon between Israel and Hezbollah. But that will depend mainly on what the United States, Iran and Israel decide.

item.title: Pope Leo Warns of Risks From A.I. in 42,300-Word Encyclical
item.description: The document marks a powerful foray by the leader of the Roman Catholic Church into the debate about the misuse or overuse of artificial intelligence.

item.title: UK Heat Wave Could Break May Temperature Record
item.description: Forecasters warned that temperatures could climb to the highest level ever recorded in the month of May, reaching 35 degrees Celsius (95 degrees Fahrenheit) in some areas of England.

item.title: Trump says U.S. and Iran nearing a peace deal. And, Pope Leo weighs in on AI's rise
item.description: President Trump says that a deal with Iran to end the war is largely negotiated. And, Pope Leo XIV weighed in today on the rise of AI during his first encyclical.

item.title: U.S.-Iran peace deal emerging, while war threats still loom
item.description: President Trump and other administration officials are tempering expectations raised of an imminent agreement to end the war in Iran while Iranian officials have signaled there are still disagreements on key issues.
